questions.question_text: The reception team had to borrow copy paper from another floor after we ______ it before noon.
questions.explanation_zh: run out of 表示用品用盡；句中交代紙張耗盡，run into 只是碰到。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The front desk may ______ visitor badges if the courier is delayed again this morning.
questions.explanation_zh: may 後接原形；語意是名牌快耗盡，所以用 run out of，不是 run into。

questions.question_text: Before the auditors arrive, Ms. Wu will ______ a temporary workspace in the small meeting room.
questions.explanation_zh: set up 表示安排或設立臨時空間；set aside 是保留，不合語境。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The operations assistant was asked to ______ a video call for the branch managers before 3 p.m.
questions.explanation_zh: 此處要安排視訊會議，固定用 set up；set aside 只有保留之意。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: If Mr. Ito has a few minutes after lunch, he can ______ our office to sign the delivery form.
questions.explanation_zh: drop by 表示順道拜訪；drop off 多指送達或下降，不是臨時來訪。

questions.question_text: Our supplier plans to ______ the office this afternoon because the sample boxes need approval today.
questions.explanation_zh: 語境是供應商順道來辦公室，因此用 drop by；drop off 偏向送下貨。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: Please ______ the revised seating chart carefully before the visitors arrive at reception for the client briefing.
questions.explanation_zh: look over 表示快速查看文件；look into 是調查，與接待前檢查不符。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The director asked me to ______ the reimbursement list once more before finance receives it.
questions.explanation_zh: 此處是再審閱名單，所以用 look over；look around 只表示四處查看。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: We may ______ a scheduling problem if the training room is still occupied at noon.
questions.explanation_zh: run into 可指遭遇問題；run out of 是耗盡，和會議室衝突不符。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The office move could ______ delays unless the IT team finishes the network check tonight.
questions.explanation_zh: 句意是搬遷可能遭遇延誤，因此用 run into；run through 不表示碰到障礙。

questions.question_text: Please ______ the guest badges from reception before escorting the clients upstairs to the training room.
questions.explanation_zh: pick up 表示拿取物件；hand in 是提交，和去櫃檯領取相反。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: Ms. Lin will ______ the signed contract from the courier desk after the afternoon briefing.
questions.explanation_zh: 語境表示到櫃檯領取文件，固定搭配用 pick up；take over 是接管，語意不同。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The receptionist will ______ parking passes to all conference guests at the lobby desk before registration opens.
questions.explanation_zh: give out 在此表示分發；give away 偏向白送或洩露，不是正式派發。

questions.question_text: Please ______ the updated evacuation cards before the safety drill begins on Friday morning at headquarters.
questions.explanation_zh: 語境表示安全演練前要分發卡片，因此固定搭配用 give out；give back 是歸還，不合句意。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The office manager expected the printer cartridges to last through Friday. However, two departments printed extra presentation packets this morning. By noon, we had ______ toner and had to delay the copies for the client visit.
questions.explanation_zh: 語境表示大量加印導致碳粉耗盡，所以固定搭配用 run out of；run into 不表用完。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The regional managers were told at 9 a.m. that the original meeting link had failed. To keep the review on schedule, the assistant quickly ______ a new video conference and emailed the access code to everyone.
questions.explanation_zh: 語境要臨時安排新會議，因此用 set up；set aside 只是擱置保留。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The purchasing director cannot stay for the full site tour because another meeting was moved forward. She said she would ______ our office after lunch, sign the samples, and then head to the airport.
questions.explanation_zh: 前後文表示短暫順道到訪，所以用 drop by；drop off 只像送人或送貨。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The assistant finished revising the visitor schedule, but the director has not approved it yet. Before the guests arrive, he wants to ______ the final version for any timing conflicts.
questions.explanation_zh: 語境表示快速審閱最終版本，所以固定搭配用 look over；look into 偏向深入調查。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: The delivery route looked simple on paper, yet a road closure was announced just before departure. As a result, the driver may ______ traffic delays and miss the first appointment.
questions.explanation_zh: 前文指出道路封閉，會遭遇延誤，所以用 run into；run out of 是耗盡。

questions.question_text: The reception desk called to say the client welcome packets had arrived early. Since the sales team is still in a cross-department briefing, could you ______ the packets and place them in the meeting room?
questions.explanation_zh: 語境是去櫃檯取回資料，固定用 pick up；pick out 是挑選特定對象，pick over 是逐件翻揀，pick off 是逐一除去。 不要誤選外形相近但語意不同的片語。

questions.question_text: Quick review: choose the best TOEIC meaning for "run out of".

options.A: to finish using all of something

questions.explanation_zh: run out of 指用品或資源用盡；易和 run into 混淆，但後者是碰到。

questions.question_text: Quick review: choose the best TOEIC meaning for "set up".

options.C: to pass something to another person

questions.explanation_zh: set up 指安排或設立；不是快速查看，也不是取消預約。

questions.question_text: Quick review: choose the best TOEIC meaning for "drop by".

options.A: to pay a short informal visit

questions.explanation_zh: drop by 固定搭配表示順道短暫拜訪；不是用完資源，也不是恢復狀態，請不要誤選外形相近的片語。

questions.question_text: Quick review: choose the best TOEIC meaning for "look over".
questions.explanation_zh: look over 指快速查看或審閱；不是分發 give out，也不是遇見 run into。

vocab_items_staged.example: The supplier will drop by the office after the client meeting.
The receptionist will give out parking passes to conference guests.
Please look over the contract summary before the director signs it.
Ms. Chen will pick up the visitor badges at reception.
Our team ran into a scheduling problem during the office move.
We ran out of toner just before the monthly reports were printed.
The assistant set up a video call for the regional managers.
